texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Purpose and Intent
texts.text: Purpose and Intent

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (1) This section of the Land Use Bylaw provides definitions and regulations for signs and outlines sign owner responsibilities. Regulations for signs within the City of Airdrie are put into place for the purposes of:
texts.text: This section of the Land Use Bylaw provides definitions and regulations for signs and outlines sign owner responsibilities. Regulations for signs within the City of Airdrie are put into place for the purposes of:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (a) Ensuring that signs are compatible with their surroundings;
texts.text: (a) Ensuring that signs are compatible with their surroundings;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (b) Providing reasonable and appropriate means for the public to locate and identify facilities, businesses, and services;
texts.text: (b) Providing reasonable and appropriate means for the public to locate and identify facilities, businesses, and services;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (c) Providing reasonable and appropriate means for businesses to identify their location, advertise goods and services, and promote their development and growth;
texts.text: (c) Providing reasonable and appropriate means for businesses to identify their location, advertise goods and services, and promote their development and growth;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (d) Ensuring that signage maintains or enhances the aesthetic appeal of development;
texts.text: (d) Ensuring that signage maintains or enhances the aesthetic appeal of development;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (e) Maintaining interests of businesses and the general public;
texts.text: (e) Maintaining interests of businesses and the general public;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (f) Encouraging positive economic development and growth for the city;
texts.text: (f) Encouraging positive economic development and growth for the city;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (g) Ensuring pedestrian and traffic safety, and;
texts.text: (g) Ensuring pedestrian and traffic safety, and;

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (h) Limiting possible adverse effects of signage on neighbouring properties.
texts.text: (h) Limiting possible adverse effects of signage on neighbouring properties.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (2) The regulations in this section are intended to prevent overconcentration, improper placement, and excessive height, bulk, number and/or coverage of signs.
texts.text: The regulations in this section are intended to prevent overconcentration, improper placement, and excessive height, bulk, number and/or coverage of signs.

texts.text: A large freestanding sign located primarily on major traffic corridors, which directs attention to a business, service, product or event that is located, conducted or produced elsewhere than the site where the sign is located;

texts.orig: Changeable Copy means:

texts.orig: Community Identification means:

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Construction means:
texts.text: Construction means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A type of sign copy which is used for the purpose of advertising items such as the provision of labour, services, materials, or financing of a development or similar project, and which is placed on the site where the project is being constructed;
texts.text: A type of sign copy which is used for the purpose of advertising items such as the provision of labour, services, materials, or financing of a development or similar project, and which is placed on the site where the project is being constructed;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Development Marketing means:
texts.text: Development Marketing means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A type of sign copy which is used to promote a new subdivision or development project, vacant lots, and/or show homes;
texts.text: A type of sign copy which is used to promote a new subdivision or development project, vacant lots, and/or show homes;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Digital Media means:
texts.text: Digital Media means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A sign feature where the message or copy of the sign incorporates a technology or method for allowing the sign to contain changeable copy without having to physically or mechanically replace the sign or its components. This includes, but is not limited to, digital signs, electronic message boards, gas station price boards, and time/temperature displays;
texts.text: A sign feature where the message or copy of the sign incorporates a technology or method for allowing the sign to contain changeable copy without having to physically or mechanically replace the sign or its components. This includes, but is not limited to, digital signs, electronic message boards, gas station price boards, and time/temperature displays;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Election means:
texts.text: Election means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A type of sign copy which is used for political advertising and campaigning during a period of a federal, provincial, municipal, school board election, referendum, or plebiscite. This also includes information signs used to identify and direct traffic to polling stations;
texts.text: A type of sign copy which is used for political advertising and campaigning during a period of a federal, provincial, municipal, school board election, referendum, or plebiscite. This also includes information signs used to identify and direct traffic to polling stations;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Fascia Sign means:
texts.text: Fascia Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A sign that is painted on or attached to the exterior face of a building and runs parallel to a building face, not projecting more than 0.3m out from the wall;
texts.text: A sign that is painted on or attached to the exterior face of a building and runs parallel to a building face, not projecting more than 0.3m out from the wall;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Illuminated, Backlit means:
texts.text: Illuminated, Backlit means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A sign feature where an artificial light source is used to illuminate the sign from the side or back of the display panel, and may be contained within the structure of the sign;
texts.text: A sign feature where an artificial light source is used to illuminate the sign from the side or back of the display panel, and may be contained within the structure of the sign;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Illuminated, Exterior means:
texts.text: Illuminated, Exterior means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A sign feature where an artificial light source is used to illuminate the sign from an external source directed to the sign copy;
texts.text: A sign feature where an artificial light source is used to illuminate the sign from an external source directed to the sign copy;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Lawn Sign means:
texts.text: Lawn Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A temporary freestanding sign commonly made of corrugated plastic or a similar type of material. Typical uses include temporary signs used to advertise election campaigns, yard sales, seasonal retail sales and specials, real estate for sale, and community events;
texts.text: A temporary freestanding sign commonly made of corrugated plastic or a similar type of material. Typical uses include temporary signs used to advertise election campaigns, yard sales, seasonal retail sales and specials, real estate for sale, and community events;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Limited Use means:
texts.text: Limited Use means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A type of sign copy which is used to advertise a location, product, event or activity on a temporary basis, either as a single event or activity over a limited duration of time, or as a regular activity that is for limited periods of time and subject to a recurring schedule (i.e. weekly, monthly). This includes but is not limited to signs for garage sales, open houses, show homes, community events, and similar signs that are temporary in nature.
texts.text: A type of sign copy which is used to advertise a location, product, event or activity on a temporary basis, either as a single event or activity over a limited duration of time, or as a regular activity that is for limited periods of time and subject to a recurring schedule (i.e. weekly, monthly). This includes but is not limited to signs for garage sales, open houses, show homes, community events, and similar signs that are temporary in nature.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Monument Sign means:
texts.text: Monument Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A freestanding sign on a supporting structure or foundation, where the base structure or foundation has an equal or greater length than the sign copy. These are intended to be lower-profile signs and may also include associated landscaping;
texts.text: A freestanding sign on a supporting structure or foundation, where the base structure or foundation has an equal or greater length than the sign copy. These are intended to be lower-profile signs and may also include associated landscaping;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Mounted Sign means:
texts.text: Mounted Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A flat sign affixed to a fence or other similar structure, but not a building;
texts.text: A flat sign affixed to a fence or other similar structure, but not a building;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Portable Sign means:
texts.text: Portable Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A temporary sign mounted on a frame, trailer, stand or similar structure that is easily transported and erected for a limited time. This does not include signs attached to, or painted on, vehicles;
texts.text: A temporary sign mounted on a frame, trailer, stand or similar structure that is easily transported and erected for a limited time. This does not include signs attached to, or painted on, vehicles;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Projecting Sign means:
texts.text: Projecting Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A sign that is attached to a wall of a building and horizontally extends more than 0.3m from the building face;
texts.text: A sign that is attached to a wall of a building and horizontally extends more than 0.3m from the building face;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Public Direction means:
texts.text: Public Direction means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A type of sign copy that provides assistance in directing the public either on public or private property, and which provides no commercial message;
texts.text: A type of sign copy that provides assistance in directing the public either on public or private property, and which provides no commercial message;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Pylon Sign means:
texts.text: Pylon Sign means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A freestanding sign which is supported by columns, structures or other supports that are anchored in the ground independent of a building;
texts.text: A freestanding sign which is supported by columns, structures or other supports that are anchored in the ground independent of a building;

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Real Estate means:
texts.text: Real Estate means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A type of sign copy which is used for the purpose of advertising the sale, lease or rental of the property on which the sign is located;
texts.text: A type of sign copy which is used for the purpose of advertising the sale, lease or rental of the property on which the sign is located;
